newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia puts state milling company up for sale.
newsitem.headline: Zambia puts state milling company up for sale.

text.p: The Zambia Privatisation Agency (ZPA) on Thursday invited bids for the purchase of the state-owned Indeco Milling Ltd, an agency official said.
The official said the company, in the northern mining town of Ndola, could produce 79,000 tonnes of maize meal and 29,000 tonnes of stock feeds a year.
The company had the potential to yield over $20 million in revenue per year.
"The mill was rehabilitated in 1994 and is radically superior to almost all other mills in the country," the spokesman said.
